definitions.explanation: A public road in a city or town.
In the manner indicated; in accordance with.

examples.english: If you walk down this street, you'll see a large building on the right.

notes:
{通|とお}り has two main meanings: "street/road" (noun) and "as/in accordance with" (suffix).

AS A NOUN (street):
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{通|とお}り: this street
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{通|とお}り: big street
- {通|とお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross the street

AS A SUFFIX (manner/conformity):
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{通|とお}り: that's right, exactly
- ⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧{通|とお}り: as I said
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧{通|とお}り: as I expected
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧{通|どお}り: as scheduled

NOTE ON READING:
Attached directly to a noun, the suffix is read どおり (rendaku): ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧{通|どお}り (as scheduled), ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧{通|どお}り (as explained), ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{通|どお}り (on time).
After a verb in plain form, or after ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ / ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧, it stays とおり: ⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧{通|とお}り, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{通|とお}り.
